For months, the feds withheld evidence in the killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti. I’ve pressed the DOJ to release those records to the State investigators, including at a recent meeting. We understand that they are now sharing information with Minnesota investigators.

This is long overdue, and much more needs to be done — and I will be working to get more answers at the hearing this week. The families of Renee Good and Alex Pretti — and all of Minnesota — deserve accountability and justice.

I’ve heard from Minnesotans and local newspapers about how a new Trump mail delivery plan from the U.S. Postal Service will negatively impact them — making it slower and less reliable.

That's your paycheck, Social Security benefits, medications and news.

I'm urging the USPS to reverse this plan.

The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act is a historic win for families. 

It includes my bill to help communities modernize zoning laws and expand housing development. By assisting local governments to remove barriers and plan for growth, we can build more houses and lower costs.

Thank you to Rep. Kelly Morrison & all the elected leaders and volunteers who came together to turn that commitment into action.
